subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], Thank you for choosing our airline for your upcoming trip. We are pleased to confirm your booking for flight XYZ123 from City A to City B on [Date]. Please find attached your e-ticket for reference. For any inquiries or modifications to your booking, feel free to contact our customer service team. We wish you a pleasant journey and look forward to serving you onboard. Best regards, Airline XYZ
